title.en: Protecting Floating-Point Computation for DNN Binaries with MBA Obfuscation
title.zh: Protecting Floating-Point Computation for DNN Binaries with MBA Obfuscation

authors: Yikun Hu, Zichen Zhao, Peixiang Qin, Ziyi Zhou, Jiaping Gui, Yuandao Cai, Wensheng Tang

abstract.en: FLOB protects floating-point operations in compiled deep neural networks by lifting values to a higher-precision representation and applying mixed Boolean-arithmetic transformations. The paper reports preserved computational correctness and an average operator recovery rate of 4.51%, 32.82 percentage points lower than existing methods.
abstract.zh: FLOB 将浮点数提升至更高精度的表示空间，再应用混合布尔算术变换，以保护编译后的深度神经网络。论文报告在保持计算正确性的同时，算子平均恢复率降至 4.51%，较现有方法低 32.82 个百分点。
